en.lead: Elyoxe designs, builds and operates production software for businesses in the United Arab Emirates — covering architecture, implementation, cloud infrastructure and the operations that follow delivery.
en.approach_lead: Four commitments that apply to every engagement, written down before work starts rather than negotiated after it.
en.engagement: Fixed scope and fixed price for defined projects. Retained monthly capacity for ongoing work.
en.contact_lead: A short description of what is not working today is more useful than a finished brief. Initial consultation carries no charge.
en.foot_blurb: Development, artificial intelligence, programming and technology. United Arab Emirates.
en.form_done: Received. A reply follows within one working day.
en.form_fail: That did not go through. Try again, or use the GitHub profile to get in touch.
en.form_privacy: Nothing is stored beyond the message itself.
en.stat_note: The two domains open in a browser right now. Every number is the same one its case study reports.

ar.engagement: نطاق وسعر ثابتان للمشاريع المحدّدة. طاقة شهرية محجوزة للأعمال المستمرة.
ar.contact_lead: وصف مختصر لما لا يعمل اليوم أنفع من كرّاسة مواصفات مكتملة. الاستشارة الأولى دون مقابل.
